name: crosstabs
description: Complete auditable survey projects with 23 workflow tools and 39 statistical tools locally from Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Auditable survey crosstabs and statistical tests
interface.longDescription: Complete categorical and survey research in Codex with two local Crosstabs MCP servers. The plugin provides 23 project-workflow operations, 39 focused numerical tools, versioned evidence resources, editable PPTX/DOCX packs, tracker repair, governed open-end coding, project export, and audit history. Respondent files stay local; only explicitly approved open-end coding uses Vercel AI Gateway.
defaultPrompt: Analyze this survey file and build evidence-linked crosstabs.
Create a weighted tab book, compare waves, and export an editable report pack.
Choose the right test for this contingency table and explain assumptions.
